concerns.text: The plan creates contracts (waveform.schema.yaml, result.schema.yaml) but does not include any task that validates generated waveforms against `contracts/waveform.schema.yaml`. This leaves the waveform contract unexercised, violating the Plan ↔ Contracts consistency requirement.

Result schema (`contracts/result.schema.yaml`) requires a `delta` object with required fields (`chirp_mass`, `spin`, `distance`) for every `ParameterEstimationResult`. The plan only generates `delta` for quantized signals; baseline (float64) results would have `delta` null, which would not satisfy the schema.

The SNR bin definition `[8‑14]`, `[14‑20]`, `[20‑30]`, `[30‑50]` is described, but the plan does not explicitly state that the bins are stored or referenced in a data artifact that can be traced back to satisfy Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth). Adding a small JSON/YAML file listing the bins would make the SSoT explicit.
